data.notes:
The report gets the core right. It keeps the international-only scope and the unknown Adyen results, and it turns "that's an average. What's mine?", the missing named owner and "approvals" vocabulary into well-evidenced messaging changes. It misses several things:
- No messaging answer to "local acquiring" / "local cards, local rails".
- The runner-up tag is wrong (Support and service instead of Champion or access).
- The decider section never draws out that the CFO approval came two weeks before the last call, so the decision was made before we engaged.
- The decided section frames "decided before the room" as not holding up rather than as the true finding.
- The close omits "which findings are fixable" and the follow-up to act on the analysis to protect the US and position a win-back.
